title: vLLM OpenAI-Compatible Server
contribution: vLLM implements multiple OpenAI-style endpoints including Chat Completions, Responses, embeddings and ASR-related endpoints, with documented parameter differences.
boundary: Compatibility is partial/capability-specific rather than a formal universal standard.

title: vLLM Quickstart
contribution: vLLM can be called with the official OpenAI client by configuring base_url and api_key.
boundary: A shared client shape does not guarantee equal semantics or model capabilities.

title: vLLM multimodal inputs
contribution: vLLM's OpenAI-compatible server accepts image and other multimodal inputs for supported models.
boundary: Support depends on the served model and endpoint; some OpenAI parameters are unsupported.

title: vLLM API-key authentication limitations
contribution: vLLM warns that its API-key option does not protect every server endpoint and recommends additional hardening.
boundary: ActaKit must not infer endpoint security merely from an OpenAI-shaped key/header.
